All Implemented Interfaces:
net.dv8tion.jda.api.hooks.EventListener
public abstract class SimpleSlashCommands extends net.dv8tion.jda.api.hooks.ListenerAdapter
Abstract base class for Discord slash commands. Extends ListenerAdapter to handle Discord events and provides command structure.
